canDoYue: 你識問延遲退房費用、核對迷你吧、寄存行李到四點、攞行李牌、叫的士去機場，同埋要電郵收據。
canDoEn: Ask the late checkout fee, check the minibar, store luggage until four, take a tag number, call a taxi to the airport, and ask for the receipt by email.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Hello there. I'd like one late checkout now. What is the fee for that please?
dialogue.glossYue: 你好。我想延遲退房。費用係幾多？
dialogue.say: Hello there. I'd like one late checkout now. What is the fee for that please?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: Yes. That fee is forty dollars. Did you take anything from the minibar last night?
dialogue.glossYue: 係。費用四十蚊。你尋晚有冇拎迷你吧嘅嘢？
dialogue.say: Yes. That fee is forty dollars. Did you take anything from the minibar last night?

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: I didn't use the minibar at all. Can you store my luggage until four?
dialogue.glossYue: 我完全冇用迷你吧。可唔可以寄存行李到四點？
dialogue.say: I didn't use the minibar at all. Can you store my luggage until four?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: Yes. We can store the luggage until four and give you a tag number.
dialogue.glossYue: 可以。行李寄存到四點，我畀你一個行李牌號碼。
dialogue.say: Yes. We can store the luggage until four and give you a tag number.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Thanks. Can you call a taxi to the airport after I take that tag number?
dialogue.glossYue: 多謝。我攞咗行李牌之後，可唔可以叫的士去機場？
dialogue.say: Thanks. Can you call a taxi to the airport after I take that tag number?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: Yes. The taxi to the airport can leave once your stored luggage is fully ready.
dialogue.glossYue: 可以。行李準備好，去機場嘅的士就可以走。
dialogue.say: Yes. The taxi to the airport can leave once your stored luggage is fully ready.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Please email me the full receipt for the late checkout and the airport taxi.
dialogue.glossYue: 請電郵畀我延遲退房同機場的士嘅收據。
dialogue.say: Please email me the full receipt for the late checkout and the airport taxi.

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: Of course. I will email that receipt, and the tag number is on it.
dialogue.glossYue: 當然。我會電郵嗰張收據，上面有行李牌號碼。
dialogue.say: Of course. I will email that receipt, and the tag number is on it.
